sources.entry: Claude Usage Monitor - Track Claude usage with a live counter. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/theDanButuc/Claude-Usage-Monitor) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Claude Usage Monitor - Native macOS menu bar app that tracks Claude.ai usage with colour-coded icons and reset timers.

summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu-bar app that shows your Claude.ai usage (session, weekly, Sonnet, Claude Design, extra usage, and routine runs) in real time without an API key.
keywords: see how much claude i have left
summary.what_it_does: It runs as a menu-bar-only macOS app with no Dock icon. Clicking the icon opens a popover with progress bars for the current 5-hour session, weekly limits across all models, Sonnet usage (Max plan), Claude Design usage, monthly extra-usage credit spend, and daily Claude Code Routine runs. The menu bar text shows estimated time left based on burn rate, or the session percentage when idle, alongside the weekly percentage. It sends native notifications at 75, 80, 90, 95 and 100 percent usage, on session reset, and when routine runs are low or exhausted. It reads data directly from Claude's internal REST API using the sessionKey cookie obtained through a one-time login window, and it checks GitHub Releases hourly for updates.
use_cases: check how close I am to my Claude usage limit
keep an eye on Claude session and weekly quota from the menu bar
get warned before hitting Claude rate limits
track Claude Code routine run budget per day
monitor monthly extra usage spend on Claude
see when my Claude limit resets
how_to_run: Download ClaudeUsageMonitor.dmg from the Releases page and drag the app into Applications
Right-click ClaudeUsageMonitor.app, choose Open, then Open (or run: xattr -cr /Applications/ClaudeUsageMonitor.app)
Log in to Claude.ai in the browser window that opens on first launch
Alternatively via Homebrew: brew tap theDanButuc/tap && brew install --cask claude-usage-monitor
To build from source: xcode-select --install, then git clone the repo and run bash scripts/build.sh (add --universal for a universal binary)
notable: Calls Claude's internal REST API directly, with no DOM scraping or JS injection at runtime
Burn-rate display estimates minutes of usage left in the menu bar
Tracks Claude Code Routine daily run budgets, with plan limits read from the API
Right-click menu offers configurable refresh intervals from 30 seconds to 10 minutes
In-app DMG download with progress bar for updates
caveats: App is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so Gatekeeper must be bypassed on first launch
Relies on Claude's internal, undocumented API and a sessionKey cookie; the session may expire and require re-login
Some bars only appear on specific plans (Sonnet on Max, Routines on Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise)
